# lmw jobs search

Search job postings

```
lmw jobs search [KEYWORDS...] [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw jobs search go developer --location Barcelona
  lmw jobs search "data engineer" --workplace remote --posted week
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                help for search
  -n, --limit int           number of jobs (1-50) (default 10)
      --location string     city, region or country, as you would type it on the website
      --posted string       only jobs posted in the last day, week or month
      --workplace strings   onsite, remote or hybrid (comma-separated)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
